title: PP2C repressors of ABA signaling: targets for small molecules and MATH proteins
topic: ABA 信号通路的 PP2C 抑制蛋白：小分子与 MATH 蛋白的作用靶点
speaker: Pedro L. Rodríguez
location: 生命科学学院 138 会议室
speakerBio:
Pedro L. Rodríguez 是西班牙国家研究委员会（CSIC）研究教授，任职于 CSIC 和瓦伦西亚理工大学植物分子与细胞生物学研究所（IBMCP, CSIC-UPV）。他 1994 年获马德里自治大学分子生物学博士学位，随后在苏黎世联邦理工学院—慕尼黑工业大学 Erwin Grill 实验室从事脱落酶（ABA）信号传导博士后研究，1998 年加入瓦伦西亚理工大学研究植物非生物胁迫响应。其研究聚焦植物 ABA 信号分子机制，包括 PYR/PYL/RCAR 受体、2C 型蛋白磷酸酶和激酶在干旱响应中的作用，并开发基于 ABA 受体激动剂的生物技术工具以提升作物耐旱性。入选科睿唯安“高被引研究者”，Scopus 收录论文 166 篇，h 指数 72。近期，其团队与 Armando Albert (IQF-CSIC) 合作设计并表征新型 ABA 受体激动剂 iCB，可广谱激活 ABA 受体，在作物中减少水分散失、保护光合作用并提高水分利用效率。

Pedro L. Rodriguez is a Research Professor at the Spanish National Research Council (CSIC), affiliated with the Institute of Plant Molecular and Cellular Biology (IBMCP, CSIC-UPV), a joint institute of CSIC and Universitat Politecnica de Valencia. He received a Ph.D in Molecular Biology from Universidad Autonoma de Madrid in 1994, then conducted postdoctoral research on abscisic acid (ABA) signaling in Erwin Grill's laboratory at ETH Zurich-TU Munich, and in 1998 joined Universitat Politecnica de Valencia to study plant abiotic stress responses. His research focuses on the molecular mechanisms of plant ABA signaling including the roles of PYR/PYL/RCAR receptors, clade A PP2C phosphatases, and kinases in drought tolerance, and on developing biotechnological tools based on ABA receptor agonists to enhance crop drought tolerance. He was named a Clarivate Highly Cited Researcher; his Scopus record includes 166 papers and an h-index of 72. Recently, his team, in collaboration with Armando Albert (IQF-CSIC), designed and characterized a novel ABA receptor agonist, iCB, which broadly activates ABA receptors, reducing water loss, protecting photosynthesis, and improving water-use efficiency in crops.
